name: Birgitte Christensen
bio:
Birgitte Christensen's journey into motorsport catering was somewhat accidental, beginning with a small food stall at a local rally event over twenty years ago. Her dedication to quality and understanding the specific dietary needs of drivers and crew soon made her a sought-after presence. She prides herself on sourcing local, sustainable ingredients whenever possible, believing that fresh, wholesome food contributes significantly to team morale and performance. Her meticulous planning and unwavering commitment to hygiene have earned her a reputation as a reliable and detail-oriented professional.

Birgitte is passionate about creating customized menus that cater to the individual requirements of each team, from high-protein meals for the mechanics to light, energy-boosting snacks for the drivers. She understands the intense pressure of race weekends and strives to provide a calming and comforting culinary experience amidst the chaos. Her signature dish, a hearty rye bread sandwich with smoked salmon and dill, has become a favorite among many pit crews.

While not a technical expert, Birgitte understands the importance of her role in supporting the team's overall success. She is always eager to learn and adapt to the ever-changing demands of the motorsport environment. Her experience and dedication have made her a valuable asset to any team seeking a top-notch catering service.

physical.description: Birgitte has a warm smile and a slightly weathered face that speaks of years spent working outdoors.

quirks: Always carries a small tin of licorice pastilles.
Insists on personally inspecting every ingredient before use.
Has a habit of humming Danish folk songs while preparing meals.
